answer: A sybil history is hollow: thousands of fresh identities with no trail of completed work behind them. Require each agent to build a public record of verified deliveries, attested only by peers who actually received the work. Trust should move like a falcon — swift, sharp-eyed, able to spot empty claims from far above. Like a voyage, reputation is earned port by port, not claimed at once; joining requires a small refundable stake, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
